$comment: Master layout and source registry of the Blender-authored zones (docs/mansion-plan.md). Each zone's transform places its local origin in the world (glTF frame: x east, z south; rotY a multiple of π/2). The asset build copies titles, neighbours and transforms into public/assets/manifest.json (never edit that by hand). Neighbours that are not built yet are kept here and dropped at runtime. Zones with 'lightmap' are exported from their *_baked.blend (npm run bake -- <zone>).
